content.value: To find the elevation of top of a tower of KUET, observations were made from two stations P and R, 30 m apart. The horizontál angle measured at P between R and top of the tower was 60º15' and that measured at R between top of the tower and P station was 6820'. The angle of elevation was measured 10º45'.at R and. 10º20' at P. Staff readings on BM when the instrument was at P = 1.969 m and at R = 2.073 m. Calculate the elevation of top of the tower of KUET if BM was 200 m.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
